Messages.Body:
Hello,

Can an empty Kyoko hunt on a younger vampire using Restricted Vitae's
special hunt action ?
Can a Laibon Kyoko hunt using Earth-feeder ?

Thank you,

François

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
François wrote:
> Can an empty Kyoko hunt on a younger vampire using Restricted Vitae's
> special hunt action ?

Yes.

Treat her text as a prohibition against taking the usual hunt action
and a additional of a special hunt action. If other additional hunt
actions are also granted, then she may choose from among those options.

> Can a Laibon Kyoko hunt using Earth-feeder ?

Yes.
